dedupe_keys.name: datex ii european standard for road traffic and travel information exchange cen 16157

description: DATEX II is the reference data standard in Europe for the electronic exchange of road traffic and travel information and traffic data. It grew from a standard for exchanges between road traffic control centres into a set of standards covering urban mobility, electric vehicle charging infrastructure, logistics, electronic traffic regulations, urban vehicle access regulations and cooperative, connected and automated mobility. The content standards form the multi-part CEN specification 16157: context and framework, location referencing, situations, variable message signs, measured and elaborated data, parking, common elements, traffic management, traffic signals, energy infrastructure, machine-interpretable traffic regulations, facilities and status and fault, with TN-ITS and a JSON mapping upcoming; parts 1 to 5 and 7 are European Standards (2018 to 2021) and the others CEN Technical Specifications, with exchange protocols specified separately. The standard is maintained through CEN TC 278 and a user community with forums and an academy. Coverage is European, and it is used generically by road operators. Version 3.6 of the model was released in June 2025, and documentation, recommended profiles and model downloads are available free of charge on the DATEX II documentation portal. Caveats: it is an exchange format, not data, so the feeds themselves come from each road operator. It lets simulation and digital twin tools ingest live incidents, roadworks, closures and traffic measurements. It is related to the NeTEx and SIRI public transport standards.
